page.overview:
What is Kilian Rangers?

The Kilian Rangers were a group from Kilia IV who pledged to defend against the nefearious renegades of their world. They were active during the Galactic Civil War and made use of siang lances and shield gauntlets, the later of which they used as both a defensive item and a reminder of their oath.

In the current Star Wars canon, the Kilian Rangers were mentioned in the 2019 Star Wars Roleplaying supplement Gadgets and Gear, which was published by Fantasy Flight Games.
